description:
Because:
- Only the content server uses speed-trap, but the code lives in fxa-shared.
- The epic FXA-12722 moves the fxa-shared folders to the apps that use them.

This commit:
- Moves five speed-trap files to content-server lib/speed-trap, unchanged.
- Deletes timing-fields.js, which no file imports.
- Changes the metrics.js import to './speed-trap'.
- Removes the './speed-trap/*' exports entry from fxa-shared package.json.

Closes FXA-10671
